vocabulary.meaning_en: to do everything you can to make something succeed
vocabulary.example: We pulled out all the stops to finish the project on time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to deal with an order or document in the usual way
vocabulary.example: We process most orders within two days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a request to buy goods
vocabulary.example: The customer placed a large order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very quickly because it is very important
vocabulary.example: We need to send these documents urgently.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the most important thing to do
vocabulary.example: Customer safety is our number one priority.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to solve a problem or organise something
vocabulary.example: Can you sort out the problem with the delivery?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do your fair share of the work
vocabulary.example: Everyone on the team must pull their weight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very busy and full of activity
vocabulary.example: Monday mornings are always hectic in the office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: documents and forms for a job
vocabulary.example: I'll sort out the paperwork while you pack the goods.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large building where goods are stored
vocabulary.example: The boxes are in the warehouse downstairs.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take something to a person yourself, not by post
vocabulary.example: We'll hand deliver the contract this afternoon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a public show of products or art
vocabulary.example: The company will show its products at the exhibition.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when something happens later than planned
vocabulary.example: We're sorry about the delay to your order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: (of a price) as good as or better than other companies' prices
vocabulary.example: Our prices are very competitive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: looking after customers well
vocabulary.example: Good customer care keeps clients happy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to solve a problem when everything seemed to be going wrong
vocabulary.example: Anna saved the day by delivering the order herself.

vocabulary.meaning_en: talking on another phone call
vocabulary.example: Sorry, she's on the other line. Can you hold?

vocabulary.meaning_en: immediately, now
vocabulary.example: I'll send someone round right away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being looked after by someone you can trust
vocabulary.example: Don't worry, the project is in safe hands.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start dealing with something
vocabulary.example: We've got to get onto this order now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not busy, able to have a conversation
vocabulary.example: Are you free to talk in my office now?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stay calm and think clearly
vocabulary.example: Try to keep a clear head before the big meeting.

fine_lines.title: urgent vs important
fine_lines.explanation_ar: urgent يعني أن الأمر يجب أن يُنجز فورًا لأن الوقت ضيق. important يعني أن له قيمة كبيرة، لكن قد لا يكون عاجلًا. بعض المهام عاجلة ومهمة معًا فتصبح number one priority.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Urgent means it must be done now because time is short. Important means it matters a lot, but maybe not today. A task that is urgent and important is your number one priority.

examples.sentence: This order is urgent - the client needs it by tomorrow.
Learning new skills is important for your career.

fine_lines.title: urgent vs urgently
fine_lines.explanation_ar: urgent صفة تصف الاسم (an urgent order)، وurgently ظرف يصف الفعل (process it urgently).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Urgent is an adjective (it describes a noun). Urgently is an adverb (it describes a verb).

examples.sentence: We need to process this order urgently.

expressions.phrase: We've got to pull out all the stops.
expressions.meaning_en: We must do everything we can.
expressions.example: The client is unhappy, so we've got to pull out all the stops.

expressions.phrase: We have an order we need to process urgently.
expressions.meaning_ar: لدينا طلبية يجب أن ننجزها بشكل عاجل.
expressions.meaning_en: There is an order that must be done very quickly.
expressions.example: Team, we have an order we need to process urgently before Friday.

expressions.phrase: We need to pull out all the stops to get this sorted.
expressions.meaning_ar: علينا أن نبذل كل ما بوسعنا لحلّ هذا الأمر.
expressions.meaning_en: We must do everything possible to solve this.
expressions.example: We need to pull out all the stops to get this delivery sorted.

expressions.phrase: This is our number one priority.
expressions.meaning_en: This is the most important thing now.
expressions.example: Forget the other tasks for now - this is our number one priority.

expressions.phrase: Could someone answer that, please? I'm on the other line.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكن لأحدكم الرد على الهاتف من فضلك؟ أنا في مكالمة أخرى.
expressions.meaning_en: Ask a colleague to answer the phone because you are busy.
expressions.example: Could someone answer that, please? I'm on the other line with a client.

expressions.phrase: We're really sorry about the delay, and it won't happen again.
expressions.meaning_ar: نعتذر كثيرًا عن التأخير، ولن يتكرر ذلك.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite apology to a customer.
expressions.example: We're really sorry about the delay, and it won't happen again.

expressions.phrase: We'll send someone round right away.
expressions.meaning_en: Someone will come to you immediately.
expressions.example: Your printer isn't working? We'll send someone round right away.

grammar.title: get + something + past participle (get this sorted, get things done)
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم get + مفعول + التصريف الثالث للفعل للحديث عن إنجاز شيء حتى ينتهي، وغالبًا بجهد أو بسرعة: get this sorted (نحلّ هذا)، get things done (ننجز الأعمال).
grammar.explanation_en: Use get + object + past participle to talk about completing something, often with effort or speed: get this sorted, get things done.
examples: We need to get this order sorted today.
She always gets things done quickly.
Let's get the paperwork finished before lunch.

grammar.title: must have + past participle (guessing about the past)
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نستنتج شيئًا عن الماضي ونحن شبه متأكدين نستخدم must have + التصريف الثالث. قال توم: I must have forgotten أي «لا بد أنني نسيت».
grammar.explanation_en: When we are almost sure about something in the past, we use must have + past participle. Tom says 'I must have forgotten'.
examples: I must have left my keys at home.
The client must have received our email.
He must have forgotten the paperwork.

questions.question: 'Pull out all the stops' means…
questions.explanation_ar: pull out all the stops يعني بذل أقصى جهد.
questions.explanation_en: It means do everything you can.

questions.question: We have an order we need to process ___.
questions.explanation_ar: نحتاج ظرفًا يصف الفعل process، وهو urgently.
questions.explanation_en: We need an adverb after the verb: urgently.

questions.question: 'This is our number one priority' means it is…
questions.explanation_ar: number one priority هي الأولوية القصوى.
questions.explanation_en: It is the most important thing.

questions.question: Tom did not send the paperwork. He says, 'I must ___ forgotten.'
Where are the plastic grapes stored?
questions.explanation_en: Goods are kept in a warehouse.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: We need to get this sorting.
We need to get sorted this.
We need to get this sorted.
questions.explanation_en: The pattern is get + object + past participle.

questions.question: An 'urgent' task is one that…
questions.explanation_en: Urgent means it must be done now.

questions.question: Everyone must do their fair share of the work. Everyone must ___.
questions.explanation_ar: pull your weight تعني أن تقوم بنصيبك من العمل.
questions.explanation_en: 'Pull your weight' means do your share of the work.

questions.question: What does Anna say to the client at Nice'n'Cheesy?
choices: We're really sorry about the delay.
questions.explanation_ar: اعتذرت آنا عن التأخير: We're really sorry about the delay.
